The day's crypto news is a mixture of market positioning, fund flows, policy updates, and company decisions. The headlines below are worth reading for the detail behind them, not just the reaction on a price chart.

What is moving the conversation

U.S. dollar climbs to 18-month high as bitcoin holds firm around $86,000. A stronger dollar and rising bond yields are testing bitcoin’s resilience as fiscal concerns in France and political uncertainty in Spain weigh on the euro. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Live updates: Bitcoin above $86,000 as traders price out an October Fed hike. A weak September jobs report took a rate hike off the table, but bitcoin is still stuck below $87,000, with FOMC minutes due Wednesday. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Cardano's ADA leads gains in narrow range-bound market. In traditional markets, the U.S. Dollar Index jumped to 102.53 early today, the highest since April 2025, extending its rise from the Sept. 9 low of 98.60. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Technicals signal bitcoin shift, Ethereum gears up for Glamsterdam: Crypto Week Ahead. Your look at what's coming in the week starting Oct. 5. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Kraken operator Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank platform for 24/7 institutional crypto settlement. The two firms will initially roll out the digital assets settlement service to select institutional clients in Asia and the Gulf region with around-the-clock U.S. dollar settlement. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Bitcoin is about to get a major bullish signal it hasn't had in over a year. Key price averages are on the verge of confirming a major bullish configuration for the first time in over a year. Readers should check the original report before treating the headline as a confirmed change in the market.

Market context

Bitcoin is around $86,020 with a +0.81% 24-hour move, while Ether is around $2,713.97 with a +0.41% move. Those figures are a snapshot, not a forecast. The useful question is whether the move is supported by spot demand, volume, and a clear change in the news.

When the market is quiet, leverage and liquidity can matter as much as direction. A small headline can move price quickly when traders are positioned too closely on one side.

What to watch next

  • New ETF creations and redemptions.
  • Futures open interest and funding rates.
  • Fresh regulatory text or official statements.
  • Security warnings, outages, or custody changes.
  • Whether the reported developments become live products rather than announcements.

The fairest reading today is cautious attention. There are real developments in the industry, but none should be stretched into a guaranteed market direction.

On April 4, 2025, the SEC’s Division of Corporation Finance (the Staff) published a Statement on Stablecoins clarifying that in the Staff’s view the offer and sale of certain dollar-backed stablecoins does not involve an offer and sale of securities requiring registration under the US federal securities laws (the Stablecoin Statement). The Stablecoin Statement specifically addresses stablecoins that are designed to maintain a stable value relative to the US dollar (USD) on a one-for-one basis, [...] On December 16, 2025, the FDIC issued a notice of proposed rulemaking (the Proposal) to implement Section 5 of the Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for US Stablecoins Act (GENIUS Act). The GENIUS Act, enacted by Congress in July 2025, created a federal regulatory framework for stablecoins whereby a subsidiary of an insured depository institution could be approved to issue payment stablecoins.

items.title: Cryptocurrency Regulation: A Guide to U.S. & Global Policies | Britannica Money
items.description:
Cryptocurrency regulation in the United States has historically been fragmented, with federal agencies applying different interpretations based on the nature and use of each asset. That splintered approach began to change in 2025, when Congress passed legislation to establish a clearer framework for stablecoins and digital asset markets.

## Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs [...] Cryptocurrency regulation is no longer a theoretical debate—it’s an evolving framework that is beginning to take shape worldwide. In the United States, Congress made progress in 2025 toward establishing federal oversight of stablecoins and digital asset markets. One measure—the GENIUS Act—was signed into law. [...] In the U.S., landmark legislation enacted in July 2025 has begun defining the roles of federal agencies in regulating stablecoins and digital commodities. Although implementation is ongoing, these laws represent a shift away from case-by-case enforcement and toward a structured national policy.

First, President Trump hosted leading cryptocurrency industry representatives at the White House and urged Congress to advance the CLARITY Act, strengthening expectations of a more supportive U.S. regulatory environment for digital assets. [...] However, the market is now transitioning from the initial rally phase into a much more important confirmation phase.

The immediate outlook for Bitcoin and Ethereum has turned decisively more bullish, but the market has now entered a critical confirmation stage.

The bullish case would strengthen if: [...] The White House's renewed support for clearer crypto regulation has strengthened expectations surrounding the future U.S. digital-asset framework.

At the same time, larger Treasury buybacks helped ease pressure in the bond market and improve broader risk sentiment.

These catalysts were then amplified by a powerful short squeeze, pushing Bitcoin above $70,000 and Ethereum above $2,200.

items.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP Price Predictions Today: Why Is Crypto Falling? | Coin Gabbar (@coin_gabbar_) on X
items.description:
Article cover image

# Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP Price Predictions Today: Why Is Crypto Falling?

Coin Gabbar

Coin Gabbar@coin\_gabbar\_·

The crypto market took a step back today. The total market cap fell to $2.76 trillion, down 0.60% in the past 24 hours. Trading volume sits at $94.41 billion.

Bitcoin slipped to $78,062.80. Ethereum eased to $2,470.13. XRP dropped to $1.38. Most coins are red today, but the drop is mild, not a crash.

### Why is Crypto Market Down Today? [...] Ethereum trades at $2,472.04 today, down 1.80%. The coin has been stuck between $2,400 and $2,550 for over a week now.

Retail selling and a slowdown in demand from bigger buyers seem to be the main reasons for the sideways action.

Near-term resistance sits around $2,520 to $2,530. That level has rejected price several times in recent weeks. Each retest without a sharp rejection tends to weaken resistance over time, which raises the odds of an eventual breakout. [...] Markets are now pricing in a 60.4% chance of a rate hike at the September 16 Fed meeting, up from 39.6% odds of no change.

A month ago, the odds were close to a coin flip. Now, the market thinks a hike is more likely than not. Higher rates usually mean less money flowing into risk assets like crypto.

### Is the crypto market in fear or greed right now?

The Fear & Greed Index shows a score of 69 today. That puts the market in Greed territory.
